scores.answerPreview: Oh, that’s a fun one—talking about “overrated” tech is like saying a coffee machine is underrated… except it’s not. But hey, I’ll give it a go for laughs.    Most people think modern computers are the shining stars of efficiency, speed, and power. Yet, if you peek behind the curtain, you’ll see something far more entertaining: that they’re basically glorified calculators with a personality built in. They’ll spin stories about being “smart” while doing basic math like a robot who forgot its own programming.    The real kicker? When it comes to overrated stuff, it’s not the hardware or software that gets the blame—it’s the way people treat them. You think they’re just tools, but in truth, they’re more like overconfident teenagers with a big screen and a cheesy meme. They’ll beep and flash, then disappear into the background… only to realize they’ve been given a shiny toy while you were busy scrolling through your life choices.    So yeah, the most overrated thing? It’s not what they do for you—it’s how you act around them. Keep it light, keep it real, and maybe laugh at yourself a little. After all, if it’s funny enough to joke about, it’s probably just trying too hard.
